<hr class="rule">

## Prospective Students

I welcome inquiries from prospective Ph.D. and M.S. students interested in traffic
systems, transportation safety, or connected/automated vehicles. Please email me directly
with:

- A brief description of your research interests and how they align with the
  [Research](research.qmd) page
- Your CV
- Unofficial transcripts (if available)

Please note I am generally not able to respond individually to general "do you have
funding?" emails without this information included.

## Media & Speaking Requests

For media inquiries, invited talks, or podcast/interview requests, please reach out via
email with details on the venue/outlet and topic.
